Third-party component of the "draw in the browser" part of /d/diagram
======================================================================

  Graphviz itself is licensed under the Eclipse Public License 1.0; its source is at https://gitlab.com/graphviz/graphviz
  Source of the package: https://github.com/hpcc-systems/hpcc-js-wasm/tree/wasm-graphviz-v1.30.0
  The exact file and its SHA-256 are in PROVENANCE.json (same folder).
